description: Invoke a listed FiatDock service. PAID listings go THROUGH the gateway (POST /s/:id) so the non-custodial payment is enforced — ONE x402 payment: the full price, straight to the seller's wallet (the gateway commission is currently waived). TO BUY: call once WITHOUT `payment` to get the 402 challenge and step-by-step instructions, sign it with your own wallet, then call again with the same id/args plus `payment` set to the base64 x402 payload — the gateway settles on-chain directly to the seller and returns their response. No wallet? `npx fiatdock-mcp` with AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY signs automatically. FREE / first-party listings are forwarded to their real MCP endpoint directly (no payment). Pass the service's expected request body as `args`.

args.description: JSON payload to send to the service (e.g. an MCP JSON-RPC request body) — shape is defined by that service

id.description: Listing id (svc_…) to invoke, from search_services

payment.description: Base64 x402 v2 PaymentPayload signed by YOUR wallet, satisfying every entry in the 402's `accepts`. Omit on the first call to receive the challenge; send it on the second call to complete the purchase. Sent to the gateway as the X-PAYMENT header — FiatDock never holds the funds.

name: call_service

ok.description: true when the underlying service returned a 2xx

result.description: The service's response body — parsed JSON when it returned JSON, otherwise the raw text

routedThroughGateway.description: true if PAID (settled via /s/:id — 100% to the seller (the gateway commission is currently waived)); false if FREE/first-party direct

status.description: HTTP status returned by the service (or the gateway)

title: Call a marketplace service
